def late_reports(reports, today, limit):

```python
from datetime import date


def late_reports(reports, today, limit):
    now = date.fromisoformat(today)
    late = []
    for rid, received, acknowledged in reports:
        end = date.fromisoformat(acknowledged) if acknowledged else now
        if (end - date.fromisoformat(received)).days > limit:
            late.append(rid)
    return sorted(late)

REPORTS = [["R-1", "2026-10-20", "2026-10-21"],
           ["R-2", "2026-10-25", None],
           ["R-3", "2026-11-01", None],
           ["R-4", "2026-10-01", "2026-10-09"]]
print(late_reports(REPORTS, "2026-11-03", 5))
```
